name: Congregating
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of believers gathering together in Christ's name, promising His presence where even two or three assemble (Matthew 18:20). The faithful are encouraged not to forsake assembling but to exhort and motivate one another toward love and good works (Hebrews 10:24-25). True blessing comes from avoiding the counsel and company of the ungodly (Psalms 1:1), while actively engaging in the mission to preach the gospel to all (Mark 16:15). Together, these verses highlight congregating as both a means of spiritual encouragement and a platform for fulfilling the Great Commission.
